name: Yugi-Kaiba
description: Yugi-Kaiba Format is the first Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG format, including Legend of Blue-Eyes White Dragon (LOB) and Starter Decks Yugi (SDY) and Kaiba (SDK). There are a few Effect Monsters, power Spells, and simple Monster removal. Battle Phase dynamics are important, with cards like Trap Hole and Reinforcements to consider. This is Yu-Gi-Oh! in its simplest form.

defining_cards.name: Summoned Skull
defining_cards.why: A single tribute brought out a 2500 ATK attacker that could break through common 2000 DEF walls.

defining_cards.name: Man-Eater Bug
defining_cards.why: Setting it forced attackers to risk losing a monster to its Flip Effect, even if the Bug lost the battle.

defining_cards.name: La Jinn the Mystical Genie of the Lamp
defining_cards.why: Its 1800 ATK put it ahead of most monsters that could be summoned without a tribute.

defining_cards.name: Trap Hole
defining_cards.why: It destroyed a newly Normal or Flip Summoned attacker before it could deal battle damage.

defining_cards.name: Fissure
defining_cards.why: It removed the opponent's lowest-ATK face-up monster, making a lone tribute monster particularly vulnerable.
